evlab-wtp.name: EVLab WTP Design
evlab-wtp.tagline: Water Treatment Plant process & engineering design suite
evlab-wtp.description: Full water treatment plant design workspace — design basis, process selection, hydraulics, chemical dosing, equipment sizing, electrical, structural, BOQ/cost, drawings, standards compliance and reporting, following CPHEEO & AWWA criteria.

evlab-minicad.name: EVLab Mini CAD
evlab-minicad.description: In-browser CAD tool for quick 2D drafting and 3D visualization with layers, snapping, and export to DXF/SVG/PNG.

evlab-bim.name: EVLab BIM Viewer
evlab-bim.tagline: Unified 3D workspace connecting every EVLab tool's model
evlab-bim.description: Every EVLab software tool can publish its current 3D model into this shared workspace, so WTP process layouts, Mini CAD drawings, and future tools can all be viewed together as one connected building information model.

evlab-gis.name: EVLab GIS
evlab-gis.tagline: In-browser geographic information system & spatial analysis workbench
evlab-gis.description: Full GIS workspace for engineers — 2D/3D maps, layer management, basemaps, spatial analysis toolbox, attribute tables, geometry validation, and map layout/export, all running in the browser.

evlab-boq.name: EVLab BOQ
evlab-boq.tagline: Bill of Quantities, estimation & cost control workspace
evlab-boq.description: Professional civil engineering BOQ suite — takeoff, rate analysis, estimates, abstracts, measurement, billing, variations, cost control, materials/labour/equipment libraries, and reporting.

evlab-waterflow.name: EVLab WaterFlow
evlab-waterflow.tagline: Water distribution network modeling & hydraulic analysis
evlab-waterflow.description: Professional water distribution network workstation — build junctions, pipes, tanks, reservoirs and pumps in 2D or 3D, run hydraulic analysis, and inspect pressure, velocity, and head loss results.

evlab-sheet.name: EVLab Sheet
evlab-sheet.description: In-browser spreadsheet workspace built for engineers — multi-sheet workbooks, a full formula engine with dependency tracking, engineering-specific functions, and a project explorer, all running offline in the browser.

evlab-planner.name: EVLab Project Planner
evlab-planner.tagline: Construction scheduling, WBS & earned value management
evlab-planner.description: Full project controls workspace — WBS, Gantt scheduling, critical path analysis, resource loading, baselines, cost & earned value management (EVM), look-ahead planning, risks/issues tracking, and reporting.
